scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3528 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 3528 m come off over 75 km at around 9.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

srinagar-leh-highway-srinagar-dras.story: From Srinagar it runs 247 km to the finish; allow about 3 h 24 of riding. On the way it passes Sonamarg and Zoji La. The highest point is about 4,350 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
